The ground truth correctly interprets 'visible' as any cube with at least one exposed face during the viewing period, which totals 3 yellow cubes. The model, however, restricts its count to only those visible in a single static perspective (frame 18), leading to an undercount. This is primarily a reasoning error in counting scope, compounded by a spatial misunderstanding of perspective and temporal visibility.
